task.description: Run the ISS-106 integration test against real PostgreSQL. PRE-CHECKS FIRST (per CLAUDE.md TEST-RUNNER section): (1) verify backend DB services reachable (psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c 'SELECT 1'); if down, STOP and return FAIL severity BLOCKER naming the service. (2) bench env check: zig build bench 2>&1 | head -5; if it contains BPM_DB_URL/BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR/missing, STOP and return FAIL severity BLOCKER. If pre-checks pass: run zig build migrate (apply 085), then run the ISS-106 integration test: zig build test-integration-iss106 (the dedicated step) — and also zig build test to confirm no regressions. Write a YAML report to tests/reports/report-20260611-WF02-iss106-webhook-outbox.yaml per test guide §9. If the ISS-106 test FAILS for a code/migration reason, capture the exact failure for WF-03 routing.

issues.description: `zig build migrate` reads BPM_DB_URL, which is unset in the test environment (only BPM_TEST_DB_URL is set), so a bare `zig build migrate` fails with 'BPM_DB_URL environment variable is not set'. This is env-only, not a code/migration defect: the ISS-106 integration test provisions its own per-tenant schema via provisionTenantSchema against BPM_TEST_DB_URL and does not depend on `zig build migrate`. Verified migrate exits 0 when BPM_DB_URL points at the test DB; migration 085 applies cleanly (idempotent, reported as skip on re-run). Does not block ISS-106 sign-off.
